vi: Thiết kế S3 lifecycle policy khai báo bucket với versioning + transition object xuống tier rẻ (IA/Glacier/Deep Archive) theo tuổi dữ liệu.
Viết Terraform module khai báo EFS file system, mount target mỗi AZ, access point pin POSIX identity, chạy terraform validate/plan để xác minh cú pháp trước deploy.
So sánh sáu storage class S3 theo trục cost + retrieval latency + minimum storage duration, chọn đúng class cho từng workload (Standard cho live, Deep Archive cho archive).
Hiểu versioning + delete-marker pattern: delete trên bucket versioning không xóa thật, chỉ tạo marker; restore bằng VersionId; noncurrent_version_expiration chặn version cũ phình vô hạn.
Debug S3 bill bất ngờ bằng cách phát hiện ba nguồn ẩn: noncurrent version, incomplete multipart upload, request + egress cost.
en: Design an S3 lifecycle policy that declares a bucket with versioning plus transitions objects down to cheaper tiers (IA/Glacier/Deep Archive) based on data age.
Write a Terraform module declaring an EFS file system, mount target per AZ, access point that pins POSIX identity, and run terraform validate/plan to verify syntax before deployment.
Compare the six S3 storage classes along the axes of cost, retrieval latency, and minimum storage duration; pick the right class for each workload (Standard for live, Deep Archive for archive).

Understand versioning and the delete-marker pattern: delete on a versioned bucket does not truly delete, only creates a marker; restore via VersionId; noncurrent_version_expiration prevents old versions from growing unbounded.
Debug surprise S3 bills by identifying three hidden sources: noncurrent versions, incomplete multipart uploads, and request plus egress cost.
